channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: 7 Signs Your Heart Needs Help – An Ayurvedic View with Modern Insight
item.description: Discover seven subtle heart warning signs affecting young adults and explore non-surgical Ayurvedic remedies to reverse risks early.

item.title: 23 Years After Conviction, Gujarat HC Says One Slap Not ‘Cruelty’, Acquits Man in 1996 Suicide Case
item.description: The Gujarat High Court set aside a 2003 conviction in a 1996 suicide case, ruling that an isolated slap during a domestic dispute did not meet the legal threshold for cruelty or abetment.

item.title: Telangana Steps Up Street Food Vendors Training Under FSSAI Norms: But Can It Fix the Safety Gap?
item.description: As lakhs rely on street food daily, Telangana’s training push tests whether awareness can translate into lasting safety.

item.title: Live-In Partner Arrested For Allegedly Burning Student’s Private Parts With Sanitizer During 3-Day Captivity in Gurugram
item.description: A biotechnology student was rescued from three days of captivity and extreme physical torture by her live-in partner in Gurugram after she managed to alert her mother via a secret phone call.

item.title: Tragedy Near Ranchi as Redbird Airways Air Ambulance Crashes with Seven Onboard, Leaving One Dead
item.description: A medical evacuation flight from Ranchi to Delhi crashed in the forests of Chatra district shortly after takeoff, resulting in one fatality while six others were rescued.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh: Meerut House Fire Claims 6 Lives, Including 5 Children, in Suspected Short Circuit Tragedy
item.description: A suspected electrical fault sparked a devastating fire in Meerut’s Lisadi Gate area, killing six family members and raising urgent concerns over fire safety in densely populated neighbourhoods.

item.title: Stripped, Beaten Over Suspicion: 14 Arrested in Karnataka Mob Assault Linked to Missing Girl Case
item.description: A Mysuru resident was attacked by a mob in Mandya over missing girl allegations, prompting 14 arrests.

item.title: ‘Shirtless Protest’ at AI Impact Summit: Delhi Police Arrest Congress Youth President Uday Bhanu, Political Row Erupts
item.description: Delhi Police arrested IYC national president Uday Bhanu Chib over a protest at the AI Impact Summit, with Congress alleging political targeting and police citing security violations.

item.title: Exam Pressure Turns Fatal in UP: 49-Year-Old Man Shot Dead by Son in Lucknow
item.description: A 19-year-old allegedly killed his 49-year-old father amid academic pressure and family tensions before attempting to conceal the crime in their Lucknow home.

item.title: Trump Warns Nations ‘Playing Games’ With Trade Deals of Facing Steeper Tariffs Ahead
item.description: Taipei reassures investors and exporters after the U.S. Supreme Court overturns emergency tariffs, while President Trump signals possible new trade measures.
